packageRules.description: Ensure internal and important packages open a PRs right away, without waiting for manual approval
TypeScript majors are a toolchain migration (typecheck, declaration emit, every TS-peer'd build tool), not a dep bump; gate them behind dashboard approval while minors/patches stay fast-tracked
apps/docs needs the TypeScript 6 programmatic API for typedoc/ts-morph, so keep its typescript alias on 6.x
Group `react` and `react-dom`: React requires exact version parity between them at runtime, so they must bump atomically
Group Changesets packages, majors included: `@changesets/changelog-github` only works with the `@changesets/cli` generation it was built for, so the toolchain moves as one

Group Vitest packages. Always `chore`: vitest is test tooling (runtime-reachable only as racejar's peer range, which would otherwise make these PRs `fix`), and the changeset workflow only generates release bumps for `fix`/`feat`

`@types/*` are devDependencies in every published package (they all bundle their own declarations), so a bump changes nothing a consumer can observe. Always `chore`: these are catalog-managed, and catalog updates edit `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, bypassing the `matchFileNames`+`matchDepTypes` rules above and inheriting the preset's `fix` default, which made the changeset bot cut empty patch releases
